rules.name: Exact duplicate rows
rules.description: Rows identical to an earlier row in every column

rules.name: Duplicate order_id
rules.description: Rows whose order_id already appeared in an earlier row
rules.comment: A repeated order_id with different values indicates a broken export or a bad join, which whole-row duplicate detection cannot catch. Exact duplicate rows are counted here too, since they also repeat the order_id.

rules.name: Invalid dates: order_date
rules.description: Non-empty values that are not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date

rules.name: Invalid numeric: quantity
rules.description: Non-empty values that are not numbers

rules.name: Invalid numeric: unit_price
rules.description: Non-empty values that are not numbers

rules.name: Invalid numeric: discount_pct
rules.description: Non-empty values that are not numbers

rules.name: Invalid numeric: unit_cost
rules.description: Non-empty values that are not numbers

rules.name: unit_price below unit_cost
rules.description: Rows where unit_price < unit_cost (list price below cost)

rules.name: Outliers (IQR): quantity
rules.description: Outside Q1 - 3 x IQR .. Q3 + 3 x IQR; flagged only, never removed
rules.comment: Retail prices are right-skewed, so the standard 1.5x IQR fence flags a large share of legitimate premium products; 3.0x marks only extreme values. IQR is preferred over z-score because z-score assumes an approximately normal distribution, which price data rarely is. z-score stays available (method: zscore) for custom rule files.

rules.description: Outside Q1 - 3 x IQR .. Q3 + 3 x IQR; flagged only, never removed

rules.name: Text variants
rules.description: Same value written with different case or spacing
rules.comment: Reported only and not part of the quality score. Values are grouped after trimming, collapsing internal whitespace and ignoring case; there is no fuzzy matching, so 'Deutschland' and 'Germany' stay separate. Normalize text... merges the groups.
